shots.prompt: Night over the small blue house, a soft music-box melody seems to float out of the bedroom window as golden notes of light
lines: Some dreams are pictures. Some are places. And some… are songs.

shots.prompt: Anna in nurse scrubs pauses in the dark hallway outside Mira's door, humming softly, then leaves for her night shift
Mira sits up in bed listening, the lantern glowing silver
lines: Mom used to hum that song. I haven't heard it in years.

shots.prompt: The archive at night, the jars hum gently like a choir, golden light
Elias in the archive with a candle, mysterious smile
lines: Tonight I will show you a room I have not opened in many years.

shots.prompt: An old round wooden door carved with musical notes slowly opens in the archive, warm golden light and floating notes spill out
A circular library room full of tiny music boxes and glass jars, each with glowing floating musical notes inside, magical, warm
Theo amazed in the glowing music room
Elias speaking softly
lines: These are lost lullabies. Songs parents sang, that children forgot they ever heard.

shots.prompt: The silver light pours out of Mira's lantern and flies between the music boxes, searching
One small wooden music box on a shelf begins to glow silver and opens by itself, a tiny dancing star inside
Mira, astonished, stepping closer
lines: It found something. That music box… it's playing our song.

shots.prompt: Warm golden memory: a young Anna rocking little Mira in her arms by a window at night, a man's silhouette beside them pointing at a star
Mira with tears in her eyes, smiling
lines: Mom was singing. And Dad was pointing at the star. I remember now. I remember his voice.

shots.prompt: Theo looking at Mira gently, kind
lines: Your dad? Mira… you never talk about him.

shots.prompt: Mira, quiet and honest
lines: He went away when I was seven. I think I put the whole dream in a jar so it wouldn't hurt.

shots.prompt: Elias, warm and wise
lines: That is why it ran away. A dream wants to be remembered, even when it is sad.

shots.prompt: Suddenly the music room goes cold, jars dimming one by one, blue mist sliding under the door
The shadow in the hat appears in the round doorway, the music stops, frost spreads over the floor
lines: Sad dreams are better forgotten. Give it to me, and the hurt goes away.

shots.prompt: Mira holds the music box to her chest, defiant, glowing silver
lines: No. I want to remember. Even the sad parts.

shots.prompt: The music box plays louder, a wave of golden musical notes bursts outward and pushes the frost and shadow away
The shadow dissolves into smoke in the golden light, the jars brighten again
Theo grinning in relief
lines: Okay, new rule. When in doubt, sing at him.

shots.prompt: Dawn approaches, the bright star fades over the rooftops, the lantern glows warm on the windowsill
lines: Two nights left. Mira had found the song. Now she needed the rest of the dream.
